name: Edit Distance (Levenshtein)
description: Minimum operations (insert, delete, replace) to transform one string into another. Classic DP problem with applications from spell checking to DNA sequencing.
aim: Find the minimum number of single-character edits (insertions, deletions, or substitutions) required to change one word into another.
howItWorks: Build dp[m+1][n+1] where dp[i][j] = edit distance for first i chars of s1 and j chars of s2
Base cases: dp[i][0]=i (delete i chars), dp[0][j]=j (insert j chars)

complexity.spaceDescription: 2D table (m+1)×(n+1); can optimize to O(min(m,n)) with two rows

realWorld: Spell checkers — suggest closest dictionary word
whenToUse: Minimum edit operations between two strings
alternatives: Hamming distance — same length strings, only substitutions
